positions.title: Software Engineer, Machine Learning
positions.description: At Apple, I work on the systems behind Siri — building the ML-powered features that help millions of people get answers, stay healthy, and interact naturally with their devices. My focus sits at the intersection of machine learning engineering and conversational AI, where I develop and ship capabilities in Swift, Objective-C, Python, and C++ across the platforms used to deliver these experiences.

positions.title: Full-stack Developer
positions.description: As an independent consultant, I helped companies modernize their technology — moving legacy systems to cloud-first, containerized architectures and building the SPAs, APIs, and microservices to support them. My work ranged from designing distributed service architectures and automating CI/CD pipelines to building React front-ends and NLP-powered APIs. Alongside the technical work, I spent a lot of time mentoring development teams through these transitions — helping junior developers grow their skills and guiding teams adopting containerized deployment workflows for the first time.

positions.title: Advisory Software Engineer
positions.description: I worked on developer evangelism and relations for Watson products.  I was one of the maintainers of the Watson platform SDKs and wrote several applications demonstrating the platform and tools.    Worked in Python, Javascript, and Swift.

positions.title: Mobile Developer
positions.description:
Worked  on AllTrails iOS application and helping people find trails and bike, hike, and ski them.

This project entailed a lot of map work as well as data synchronization and location services.

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description: Small mobile consultancy specializing in innovation and product development.

positions.title: Contractor
positions.description: DevOps and Mobile development for enterprise customers helping them achieve their mobile technology goals.

positions.title: Systems Engineer
positions.description: We engineer applications for customers in almost every industry. From embedded software for a military rocket-launcher to a medical facility iPhone app to an inventory management iPad app – we have the business and technical expertise to engineer award-winning applications.

positions.title: Lead Application Developer
positions.description: I solve data capture and research informatics problems with Objective C, Clojure, and a bunch of other tools.  iRx Reminder provides state-of-the-art longitudinal research tools for gerontechnology, ecological momentary assessment, medication adherence, and protocol compliance.

positions.title: Sr. Mobile Developer (Interactive)
positions.description: eCards and Entertainment mobile application developer.

positions.title: Developer
positions.description: Developer for a small game development house in Akron, OH.  BlueFrog is a Y-Combinator seeded startup with games on iPad,  Facebook, the Web, etc.

positions.title: Technology Architect
positions.description: Develop applications to support clients.

positions.title: Lead Web Developer
positions.description: Develop and maintain all aspects of Dix Communications newspaper online content delivery system for web and mobile (which is mostly iPhone). The main system is a custom CMS.  Work with stakeholders at the various properties and help them achieve their online goals. Train staff on analytics, multi-media,  anything they need to know about. Mentor Jr. developers.   Other duties as assigned.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Soliant is a small consultancy specializing in FileMaker and Web development. I worked directly with clients and gathered requirements on projects including integrated applications (database development, web development, etc).

Client interaction and support are keys to the success of most of Soliants projects. The key stake-holders in most of the projects I worked on were non-technical and were often attempting to encode fuzzy work-flow and business logic into the application systems we created for them. I recommended and negotiated aspects of development while being constrained in budget and time. Additionally, as part of the "techstaff" group at Soliant I provided infrastructure and technology support internally and sometimes externally.

positions.title: Various
positions.description: Independent consultant and volunteer.  Disaster services/training and support for the Red Cross (Katrina/Rita and Loudon County, VA).  Various community outreach projects.  Project management training and support to an education software company.  Filemaker/Web development for a Chicago based consultancy.

positions.title: writer
positions.description: Wrote a book

positions.title: Infrastructure Group Manager
positions.description: Tradelink is a mid-sized trading firm, specializing in finding and exploiting market opportunity. The firm trades 5x24 from several offices throughout the world, with locations in Chicago, Hawaii, Tokyo and London. In addition to my technical duties, I was also tasked with project management duties.

positions.title: Sr. Systems Administrator
positions.description: First Options of Chicago (FOC) cleared approximately 50% of all the options traffic at the CBOE. I was responsible for a variety of system maintenance tasks and mentoring Jr. admins. I was also responsible for project management of all projects I led, which included liaising with development and operations.

positions.title: System Administrator
positions.description: IBM/GS employee on the ComEd contract.  I spent most of my time in the Joliet Data Center on the South Side of Chicago.

educations.schoolName: Lake Forest Graduate School of Management

projects.title: Improving Response to Sudden Cardiac Arrest
projects.description: Response to Sudden Cardiac Arrest (SCA) requires an integration of many services. Our project aims adopts a systems approach to improving the quality of information available to stakeholders with the aim of reducing the time between SCA and Defibrillation via an Automated Defibrillator Device (AED). Feel free to contact us for more information.
